summary: New Zealand localization of Business Central 29. It adds GST (with prepayment and full-GST handling), withholding tax (WHT), BAS and IRD number fields, tax invoices and adjustment notes, EFT vendor payments, post-dated checks, cost-plus pricing and local reports. Use it for questions on NZ tax, banking and address functionality.
overview:
The NZ layer is built on a shared APAC code base. It extends W1 posting with GST and withholding tax. Fields such as WHT Business/Product Posting Group, ABN, IRD No., Adjustment, BAS Adjustment and ACY (additional reporting currency) amounts are added to master data, documents and ledger entries. VAT Entry gets the Adjustment, BAS and settlement fields. Codeunit 12 "Gen. Jnl.-Post Line" gains procedures for WHT, GST and ACY. Codeunit 80 "Sales-Post" and codeunit 90 "Purch.-Post" gain procedures for WHT, prepayment VAT and ACY. GST posting procedures are added to codeunits 815 and 816 (invoice posting) and 442 and 444 (prepayments). Own objects include WHTManagement (codeunit 28040), TaxInvoiceManagement (codeunit 28070), BAS Management (codeunit 11601) and the WHT, BAS and Posted Tax Invoice pages. Learn documents WHT setup, WHT settlement, WHT revenue types, vendors without IRD numbers, GST posting, GST on prepayments, GST settlement and IRD numbers with adjustment notes.

Banking and payments are covered by EFT (EFT Management codeunit 11603, EFT Register, Create EFT File and Transfer EFT Register reports), post-dated checks and check installments. Reports include Deposit Slip, Bank Account Reconciliation, Bank Detail Cashflow Compare, Balance Sheet, Income Statement and AU/NZ Statement. Several objects come from the shared APAC code and are not described on the NZ Learn pages. Examples are the WHT PND reports (WHT PND 1 to 3, WHT Report - PND 53) and the E-Filing and WHT E-Filing reports.

Other capabilities are address handling (postal code lookup, AMAS validation, DPID bar codes), cost-plus pricing on price lines, and Peppol PINT A-NZ e-invoicing through the E-Documents framework. The Learn pages in the input describe the e-invoicing setup, and the code summary does not show the objects behind it.
key_points: Withholding tax: WHT posting groups, revenue types, posting setup, WHT Entry, settlement via report 28041 "Calc. and Post WHT Settlement", and certificates.
GST: GST enabled in General Ledger Setup, full GST and GST on prepayments, GST sales and purchase entries, and settlement through report 11603 "Calculate GST Settlement".
IRD No. and ABN fields on company, customer, vendor and contact records, plus adjustment notes using Adjustment Applies-to and reason codes.
Tax invoices and tax credit memos: separate posted tax document pages, number series, and print codeunits.
EFT vendor payments with Bank Account EFT fields, EFT Register, and reports to transfer the register and create the EFT file.
Post-dated checks, check installments, deposit slips and bank reconciliation reports.
Cost-plus pricing fields (Published Price, Cost, Cost-plus %) on price list lines, worksheet lines and sales prices.
Address support through counties, postal codes, AMAS validation and DPID bar codes; e-invoicing in Peppol PINT A-NZ format via E-Documents.

areas.what: Adds the core tax layer: WHT management and entries, GST entries and settlement, BAS setup and calculation, tax invoice management and post-dated checks. W1 posting codeunit 12 "Gen. Jnl.-Post Line" and tables such as Gen. Journal Line, VAT Entry and General Ledger Setup get many new fields, events and procedures for WHT, GST and ACY amounts.
areas.why: Learn describes WHT as reducing vendor payments by tax withheld, and describes GST posting setup, GST settlement and adjustment notes for correcting taxable supply information.

areas.what: Purchase documents and vendors get ABN, IRD No., WHT groups, adjustment fields, tax document flags and ACY amounts. Purch.-Post and prepayment posting add WHT and GST procedures. Vendor Registration Warning and tax invoice number series are added to setup.
areas.why: Learn covers vendors without IRD numbers for WHT and entering IRD numbers for tax compliance.

areas.what: Sales documents and customers get IRD No., WHT groups, adjustment fields, tax document type and ACY amounts. Sales-Post, prepayment posting and invoice posting add WHT and full-GST handling. The own report 17110 "AU/NZ Statement" is added.
areas.why: Learn explains GST on prepayments and adjustment notes (credit memos) for correcting GST amounts.

areas.what: Company Information gets ABN, IRD No., WHT Registration ID and tax period fields. New county and address objects support postal lookups, with AMAS and bar code support through Format Address. DateFilter-Calc gets period procedures.
areas.why: Learn describes postal code lookups, region validation and DPID bar code generation for postal efficiency.

areas.what: Adds EFT payments (EFT Management, EFT Register, create and transfer reports) and EFT fields on Bank Account. Also adds deposit slip, bank reconciliation and cash flow comparison reports, aged back-dating reports and check ledger fields for WHT and post-dated checks.
areas.why: Learn documents EFT vendor payments, bank cash flow comparison, deposit slips and bank reconciliation printing.

areas.what: Adds WHT Product Posting Group to Item, Item Template and Item Charge, plus a vendor exchange rate field on Item Journal Line. ItemCostManagement gets cost-plus price update procedures and an event. Own reports Stock Card and Stock Movement are added.
Adds bar code management with checking and batch job reports, used with address bar code (DPID) functionality.
areas.why: Learn describes DPID bar code generation for postal efficiency.

areas.what: Price List Line and Price Worksheet Line get Published Price, Cost, Cost-plus % and Discount Amount fields, with procedures that update unit price from the cost-plus percentage.
areas.why: Learn explains setting sales prices by cost-plus percentage.

areas.what: The LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets are changed to cover the NZ objects.
Adds an APAC service document management codeunit and a Service Manager role center page extension.
A table extension adds APAC source code fields.
Contact gets ABN, Registered, ABN Division Part No. and IRD No. fields.
areas.why: Learn covers entering IRD numbers for tax compliance.

areas.what: Adds an NZ expense event subscriber codeunit.
Fixed Asset gets a WHT Product Posting Group field.
Data Migration Facade Helper gets a procedure to create a county when needed.
Incoming purchase document pre-mapping can find a vendor by ABN and adds an event after the header data is set.
Resource gets a WHT Product Posting Group field.

issues: The overview calls the WHT PND reports 'Thai-style' and the e-filing reports 'Philippine-style'. The input never names those countries, so these labels come from outside knowledge. The reports are now described only by their names from the input (WHT PND 1 to 3, WHT Report - PND 53, E-Filing, WHT E-Filing).

The overview said codeunits 80 and 90 gain procedures for GST. Their added procedures in the input cover WHT, prepayment VAT and ACY, but no procedure is named for GST. GST posting procedures appear in codeunit 12 (InsertGSTReport), codeunits 815/816 and codeunits 442/444, so the sentence now says that.

Small point, left as it is: the overview groups VAT Entry with master data and documents as getting WHT, ABN and ACY fields. VAT Entry only gets the Adjustment, BAS and settlement fields. The wording is general enough to keep.
